dct_title_s: Revised plan for the improvement of Riverside Park extension, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A revised plan for the improvement of the Riverside Park extension in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-fourth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 63.
